answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit ferrous bond and posts a cipher of its planned work. Within ninety minutes it reveals the preimage and fresh work; an auditor checks the cipher matches. A relic cipher from a past epoch cannot match fresh work; copies and rented reveals burn it. Fees rise per funding key: first 38, the k-th 38+9(k-1), so 1,000 fakes pay 4,533,500 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once and recovers its bond.
